decisions.statement: A value of this kind is a rule beside whether that rule counts from the last completion.
A value that is a rule alone counts from the occurrence rather than the doing.
A page type stating what a rule counts from beside the rule states it that way.
A value of this kind is drawn as the rule reads in words rather than as its iCalendar text.

definition: a page property holding a recurrence rule and what that rule counts from
